purpose: distinguish acute temperature association from seasonal-date confounding and report the already-fitted joint-model rain coefficient
data_rule: same [-10,45] C plausible-temperature filter used in NAAMP_TEMP_QC_CONTRACT_V0_1, >=8 valid stop temperatures

joint_readback.formula: prop ~ rain_z + temp_z + C(State) + C(RunNumber) + C(RouteType) + year_z

seasonal_date_robustness.doy_definition: calendar day of year parsed from SurveyDate
seasonal_date_robustness.formula: prop ~ rain_z + temp_z + bs(doy, df=5, degree=3) + C(State) + C(RunNumber) + C(RouteType) + year_z
seasonal_date_robustness.temperature_robust_if: temp_z remains >0 with 95% cluster-robust CI excluding 0
seasonal_date_robustness.rain_robust_if: rain_z remains <0 with 95% cluster-robust CI excluding 0
